steps.tactic:
induction fuel with
| zero =>
  intro s₁ s₂ hrel hgame

| succ fuel ih =>
  intro s₁ s₂ hrel hgame
  simp only [op869_sequential_goal_game] at hgame ⊢
  obtain ⟨a₁, ha₁, hnext⟩ := hgame
  obtain ⟨ …
obtain ⟨a₂, ha₂, hresponses⟩ := hstep s₁ s₂ hrel a₁ ha₁
obtain ⟨r₁, hr₁, hrel'⟩ := hresponses r₂ hr₂
rcases hnext r₁ hr₁ with hgoal₁ | hgame₁
